verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships an official Snowflake CLI documented for creating, managing, updating, and viewing apps across Streamlit, Native Apps, Snowpark Container Services, and Snowpark, confirmed by a dedicated docs probe. It's a general developer CLI rather than one purpose-built for AI-native/agentic workflows specifically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of CLI usage, and explicit agentic-workflow-specific CLI features (vs. general app management).
